commentary.text: Lineups are announced and the players are warming up.
First Half begins.
Albion building from the back, pushing forward into the final third.
Big chance for Albion! A through ball releases the striker.
Rovers on the attack now, building pressure down the right.
Midfielder (Rovers) wins a free kick in the defensive half.
Rovers surging forward, quick transition through midfield.
Corner, Rovers. Conceded by a defender.
Corner taken by Rovers, headed clear at the near post.
The ball is played back and Rovers recycle possession.
Throw-in deep in midfield.
The ball runs out of play for a goal kick. A lull in the game.
Both sides catching their breath, possession traded in midfield.
Rovers working it wide, building an attack down the flank.
Corner, Rovers. Conceded by the full-back.
Albion pressing forward again, in the final third.
Winger (Albion) wins a free kick in the attacking half.
Albion free kick is played short and worked into the wall, cleared away.
Rovers on top now, building pressure with a series of attacks.
Rovers dangerous attack, a cut-back across the six-yard box.
Attempt saved. A fierce drive is turned around the post.
Rovers keep coming, another attack down the left.
Shot on target by Rovers, forces a save low to the right.
Albion breaking into the box, a real chance here.
A scrappy spell, the ball pinging around midfield, out for a throw.
Defender (Rovers) wins a free kick in the defensive half.
Striker (Albion) wins a free kick in the attacking half.
Albion free kick whipped in, headed away by the defence.
Rovers building again, sustained pressure, a real spell on top.
Rovers counter-attack, three on two, golden chance!
Attempt missed. The shot flashes wide of the far post.
The referee is checking the monitor — VAR review for a possible penalty to Albion.
VAR Decision: No penalty. Play continues, the appeals waved away.
Albion win a free kick in the defensive half as the half winds down.
Throw-in, the ball worked back to the keeper.
First Half ends, Albion 2, Rovers 1.
Second Half begins. Albion 2, Rovers 1.
Albion straight on the front foot, building pressure.
Albion dangerous attack, cutting it back across the box.
Corner, Albion. Conceded by the centre-back.
Albion corner headed over the bar.
Albion relentless, another dangerous attack into the area.
Shot on target by Albion, tipped onto the bar!
Albion still all over them, sustained siege pressure.
Playmaker (Albion) wins a free kick in the attacking half.
Rovers respond, pushing forward in numbers now.
Rovers on the attack, building real pressure of their own.
Rovers dangerous attack, a driving run into the box.
Shot on target by Rovers, a stinging save needed!
Corner, Rovers. Conceded by the right-back.
Rovers corner cleared to the edge, recycled and lost.
Rovers breaking forward, a clear chance through the middle!
A scrappy, quiet spell — throw-in, ball out for a goal kick.
Possession traded in midfield, the tempo drops right off.
Another stoppage, the ball out of play. The game has gone flat.
The referee goes to the pitchside monitor — VAR review for a possible red card, Rovers.
Albion pressing the advantage against ten men, on top.
Albion dangerous attack, swinging it into the box.
Corner, Albion. Conceded by the left-back.
Albion corner met by a header, just wide.
Shot on target by Albion, superbly saved!
Albion still pushing, relentless pressure now.
VAR review — checking a possible penalty for Albion, handball in the area.
Rovers throwing everyone forward, a late rally.
Substitute (Rovers) wins a free kick in the attacking half.
Rovers free kick dropped into the box, headed clear.
Rovers dangerous attack, one last surge into the area.
The ball is shielded out for a throw, time being run down.
Albion on the attack as we move into stoppage time.
Corner, Albion. Conceded deep in stoppage time.
Albion corner swung in, scrambled away on the line.
Shot on target by Albion! Saved at the death.
The referee brings the game to an end.

keyEvents.text: Goal! Albion 1, Rovers 0. Open-play move finished low into the bottom corner. Assisted by the winger.
Goal! Albion 1, Rovers 1. Header from a corner, bundled in at the back post.
Penalty awarded to Albion after a foul in the box.
Goal! Albion 2, Rovers 1. Penalty scored, sent the keeper the wrong way.
Goal! Albion 3, Rovers 1. Curling shot scored directly from the free-kick into the top corner.
Goal! Albion 3, Rovers 2. Slotted home from open play after a flowing move. Assisted by the substitute.
Rovers defender is shown a straight red card after the VAR review.
Penalty awarded to Albion after the VAR review for handball.
Penalty missed! The spot-kick is blazed over the bar.
